allow_experimental_analyzer.direction: Enables the analyzer and planner used to build query plans.
allow_experimental_analyzer.when_to_suggest: When an older profile still disables the analyzer and the plan misses analyzer-only optimizations.
allow_experimental_analyzer.note: Legacy name; enable_analyzer is its current alias.

allow_experimental_parallel_reading_from.direction: Allows a SELECT to split MergeTree reads across replicas.
allow_experimental_parallel_reading_from.when_to_suggest: For large scans on replicated data after checking replica topology and query compatibility.
allow_experimental_parallel_reading_from.note: Legacy experimental control; current releases use enable_parallel_replicas and related parallel_replicas settings.

enable_analyzer.direction: Enables the analyzer and planner used to build query plans.
enable_analyzer.when_to_suggest: When a profile disables it and the query depends on analyzer-only planning or optimization.
enable_analyzer.note: Alias of allow_experimental_analyzer retained under the non-experimental name.

enable_filesystem_cache.direction: Caches data read from remote filesystems.
enable_filesystem_cache.when_to_suggest: For repeated object-storage reads where the service and storage policy expose a filesystem cache.
enable_filesystem_cache.note: Relevant to remote/object-storage scans; cache availability and sizing are service controlled.

join_algorithm.direction: Chooses one or more JOIN implementations with different memory, sorting, and spill behavior.
join_algorithm.when_to_suggest: When a JOIN is the bottleneck and its shape, key types, and memory evidence support testing another documented algorithm.
join_algorithm.note: Algorithm order is preference order; not every algorithm supports every JOIN shape.

max_bytes_before_external_group_by.direction: Starts external aggregation after the operation reaches the byte threshold; zero disables this absolute threshold.
max_bytes_before_external_group_by.when_to_suggest: When GROUP BY memory pressure is observed and temporary storage can absorb spill I/O.
max_bytes_before_external_group_by.note: Cloud defaults this to half the memory per replica; test spill cost rather than assuming lower is faster.

max_bytes_before_external_sort.direction: Starts external sorting after the operation reaches the byte threshold; zero disables external sorting.
max_bytes_before_external_sort.when_to_suggest: When ORDER BY memory pressure is observed and temporary storage can absorb spill I/O.
max_bytes_before_external_sort.note: Cloud defaults this to half the memory per replica; spilling trades memory for I/O.

max_memory_usage.direction: Limits RAM used by one query on one server; zero means unlimited.
max_memory_usage.when_to_suggest: When measured query memory approaches the limit; account for user and server limits too.
max_memory_usage.note: The Cloud default depends on replica RAM, so do not infer a safe value from the plan alone.

max_parallel_replicas.direction: Caps replicas used for parallel query execution.
max_parallel_replicas.when_to_suggest: For a large Cloud scan after confirming parallel replicas are enabled and applicable.
max_parallel_replicas.note: A value greater than one can distribute eligible scans across replicas.

max_threads.direction: Caps parallel query-processing threads; lower values generally reduce memory use.
max_threads.when_to_suggest: On self-hosted servers when CPU and memory measurements show that query parallelism is mis-sized.
max_threads.note: ClickHouse Cloud derives auto(N) from service vCPUs; service sizing, not a cache-path-style tweak, owns this limit.

optimize_move_to_prewhere.direction: Moves eligible WHERE predicates to PREWHERE for MergeTree reads.
optimize_move_to_prewhere.when_to_suggest: When a selective scan-local predicate remains in WHERE and EXPLAIN SYNTAX shows no PREWHERE.

optimize_read_in_order.direction: Allows MergeTree data to be read in primary-key order for compatible ORDER BY queries.
optimize_read_in_order.when_to_suggest: When an ORDER BY matches table order but the plan still performs a separate sort.
optimize_read_in_order.note: Whether it applies depends on the ORDER BY expression and table sorting key.

parallel_replicas_*.direction: Controls planning, coordination, filtering, and read-task behavior for parallel replicas.
parallel_replicas_*.when_to_suggest: For large Cloud scans after checking that the specific setting applies to the table engine and query shape.
parallel_replicas_*.note: Treat the family as coordinated controls, not independent speed switches.

query_plan_*.direction: Controls named query-plan transformations and their limits.
query_plan_*.when_to_suggest: Only when the setting name and plan shape identify the same transformation and EXPLAIN can verify the effect.
query_plan_*.note: Each query_plan setting is narrow; use its catalog description before changing it.

use_query_condition_cache.direction: Caches query conditions so repeated filters can skip granules on later runs.
use_query_condition_cache.when_to_suggest: For recurring selective filters on MergeTree data, not a one-off full scan.
use_query_condition_cache.note: The cache helps repeated conditions and does not replace primary-key alignment.

use_uncompressed_cache.direction: Uses the uncompressed-block cache for repeated short MergeTree queries.
use_uncompressed_cache.when_to_suggest: On self-hosted deployments with many repeated short reads and an intentionally sized server cache.
use_uncompressed_cache.note: Large reads bypass it automatically; server-side cache sizing is separate.
